answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL generation is a rapidly growing area of natural language processing with significant realworld applications.

answer_2.quote: Key evaluation metrics for text-to-SQL generation are: Execution Accuracy (EX), Exact Match (EM), and Validity and Efficiency Score (VES).

answer_3.quote: Other methods use pre-trained LLMs like GPT-4 to judge the quality of the sampled generations to select the best one.
methods: judging the quality of sampled generations
